page.content:
Chinese textile that named the road in later European speech.

How Silk connects

  • Topic: Silk Road — Chinese silk is the good that later named the whole network.
  • Faction: Parthian Empire — Parthia mediated Chinese silk toward the Roman world.
  • Location: Maritime silk route — Silk also moved on ships when monsoon freight undercut the caravan.

What is Silk?

Silk was the prestige good Romans already associated with the Seres. It moved west as yarn and cloth; sericulture itself later leaked to Central Asia and Byzantium.

Key threads lead to Silk Road, Parthian Empire and Maritime silk route.
